slotStart.description: Exact start timestamp copied verbatim from checkAvailability slot.start.

slotEnd.description: Exact end timestamp copied verbatim from checkAvailability slot.end. Never infer it from duration or the spoken label.

language.description: Conversation language for the automatic booking confirmation SMS.

phoneE164.description: Confirmed callback number stored on the booking. If the caller confirmed using the number they are calling from, reuse that live caller number here.

phoneRaw.description: Clear raw callback number captured during the call when the assistant skips a dedicated normalization webhook.

isExistingPatient.description: Whether the caller is already a patient.

patientPhoneE164.description: Optional deterministic fallback filled from the confirmed lookupPatient alias when Vapi carries it forward.

patientPhoneRaw.description: Optional raw callback number fallback when the assistant intentionally skips lookupPatient to keep latency low.

callerPhoneE164.description: Optional live caller number in E.164 format when Vapi exposes it.

callerPhoneSource.description: Optional source label for the live caller number.
